high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a text-based article or news report. The title at the top reads "3I/ATLAS and clues about alien life." The text discusses a scientific discovery made by scientists in August. It mentions that hydroxyl (OH) gas, which is a chemical fingerprint of water, was observed coming from an interstellar comet named 3I/ATLAS. The article explains that when comets approach the Sun, the water ice on their surface turns into gas. However, it notes that 3I/ATLAS was releasing jets of water vapor even when it was nearly three times farther from the Sun
